```yaml
name: Dispatch critical workflows for merge queue
on:
  merge_group:
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: write
jobs:
  dispatch:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Dispatch critical workflows
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const workflows = [
              'lints.yml',
              'build.yml',
              'vm.yml',
              'cli.yml',
              'primitives.yml',
              'sdk.yml',
              'recursion.yml',
              'extension-tests.yml',
              'riscv.yml',
              'guest-lib-tests.yml',
              'benchmarks.yml',
              'benchmarks-execute.yml',
              'docs.yml',
              'native-compiler.yml'
            ];
            const ref = github.context.payload.pull_request?.head?.ref;
            if (!ref) {
              core.setFailed('Could not determine PR head ref');
              return;
            }
            for (const wf of workflows) {
              core.info(`Dispatching ${wf} on ref ${ref}`);
              await github.actions.createWorkflowDispatch({
                owner: github.context.repo.owner,
                repo: github.context.repo.repo,
                workflow_id: wf,
                ref: ref
              });
            }
```
